name: Jianuo Xuan
title: Designer
bio: Jason Xuan is an interdisciplinary designer working across architecture, XR, and AIGC. He is currently pursuing a Master of Architecture II at the Harvard Graduate School of Design. With work experience in the United States, Denmark, and China, his practice centers on tangibility, visuality, and product thinking. He works across architecture, spatial design, AI hardware, and UI/UX.
